items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He used Virgil Davis on the alto... I had to play first trombone.

ctx.x: Britt Woodman couldn't work it because he wasn't a member of the New York union then. And they got -- for some reason or other they got Ray Nance to work it, you know. Shorty Baker couldn't work it because he wasn't a member of 802 yet. But -- so I had to play first trombone. Rick Bert Henderson couldn't make it because he wasn't 802, so they used a lot of guys that -- Ward Sillaway was the contractor out there and Ward used a lot of guys that had been formerly with the Waring band. He used Virgil Davis -- we…
Oh, yes. I know Betty very well.
